meta.title: useState — derived state mirrored in an effect lags a render behind

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Cart shows the same total two ways: copied into its own state by an effect, and computed directly during render. Compare the two numbers on the frame right after you add an item.

annotations.label: Syncing state in an effect
annotations.detail: Effects are for talking to things outside React. Copying one piece of state into another costs an extra render pass and shows users a frame where the two disagree.

annotations.label: Derived during render
annotations.detail: No state, no effect. If the calculation is expensive, wrap it in useMemo, but start with a plain expression.
